answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose commitments bind each Semaphore identity to its rate-limit nullifiers. A zero-knowledge proof enforces one message per horizon without exposing the witness. Reusing a nullifier yields Shamir shares that interpolate the agent’s epoch private key, allowing verifiable attribution and immediate collateral slashing. The inlet checks proof and polynomial consistency; a raven-like watcher can submit duplicate-message evidence.
